mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_quota ( sensor_id, free_voice_count, free_sms_count, balance, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{sensorId}, #{freeVoiceCount}, #{freeSmsCount}, #{balance}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_quota SET free_voice_count = #{freeVoiceCount}, free_sms_count = #{freeSmsCount}, balance = #{balance}, update_time = NOW() WHERE sensor_id = #{sensorId}
UPDATE notification_quota SET free_voice_count = free_voice_count - 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE sensor_id = #{sensorId} AND free_voice_count > 0
UPDATE notification_quota SET free_sms_count = free_sms_count - 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE sensor_id = #{sensorId} AND free_sms_count > 0
UPDATE notification_quota SET balance = balance - #{balance}, update_time = NOW() WHERE sensor_id = #{sensorId} AND balance >= #{balance}
UPDATE notification_quota SET balance = balance + #{balance}, update_time = NOW() WHERE sensor_id = #{sensorId}
UPDATE notification_quota SET free_voice_count = free_voice_count + #{freeVoiceCount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE sensor_id = #{sensorId}
UPDATE notification_quota SET free_sms_count = free_sms_count + #{freeSmsCount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE sensor_id = #{sensorId}
